# Applications by activity

Every application the catalog carries, laid out the way the desktop menu is: one
chapter per activity, one section per thing a person looks for. **332
applications.** A program with several tags is listed under each.

Each entry links to its page, which says what it does and why you would want it,
what to configure first, known problems, how it installs and where to get help.
After the dash: **in `profile`** means `hammunition install PROFILE` brings it
in; **by name only** means no profile includes it, so
`hammunition install NAME` is how you ask for it. *(retired)* marks a unit the
catalog keeps for the record. The [package reference](packages/index.md) lists
the same applications by bare tag, and the [profiles](profiles/index.md) say
what each bundle is for. For the five activities with a hub page, GPS and
time, APRS, Meshtastic, Reticulum and MeshCore, start from the
[activity hubs](activities/index.md).

## Operate the Station

Control the rig, keep the log, work the cluster, set the clock and the position.

### Rig Control (CAT)

CAT control of a transceiver while operating: frequency, mode, PTT and the panel on the screen.

- [aethersdr](packages/aethersdr.md) — Linux client for FlexRadio transceivers (by name only)
- [cqrlog](packages/cqrlog.md) — Full-featured station log with a database behind it and rig control in front (in [`logging`](profiles/logging.md))
- [flrig](packages/flrig.md) — Rig control with a real front panel, shared between programs over XML-RPC (in [`digital-modes`](profiles/digital-modes.md), [`station`](profiles/station.md))
- [flwkey](packages/flwkey.md) — Control panel for the Winkeyer hardware CW keyer (in [`morse`](profiles/morse.md))
- [icom](packages/icom.md) — Minimal CI-V control for Icom radios from the command line (by name only)
- [kappanhang](packages/kappanhang.md) — Opens an Icom network radio as an ordinary sound card and serial port (by name only)
- [kel-agent](packages/kel-agent.md) — Bridges browser-based logging software to the radio hardware on your desk (by name only)
- [klog](packages/klog.md) — Cross-platform Qt station log that stays out of the way (in [`logging`](profiles/logging.md))
- [libhamlib-utils](packages/libhamlib-utils.md) — The command-line tools for hamlib — test a radio before blaming software (in [`satellite`](profiles/satellite.md), [`station`](profiles/station.md))
- [pihpsdr](packages/pihpsdr.md) — Operator program for OpenHPSDR transceivers -- ANAN, Hermes Lite 2 and their kin (in [`sdr`](profiles/sdr.md))
- [qlog](packages/qlog.md) — Modern Qt station log with award tracking and online-service upload (in [`logging`](profiles/logging.md))
- [quisk](packages/quisk.md) — SDR transceiver software with a real front panel, driving hardware or a dongle (in [`sdr`](profiles/sdr.md))
- [rig-service](packages/rig-service.md) — One shared rigctld for the station's rig, as a systemd user service (in [`station`](profiles/station.md))
- [ser2net](packages/ser2net.md) — Serve a serial port over TCP, so a rig's CAT port can be reached from another machine (by name only)
- [wfview](packages/wfview.md) — Control a modern Icom radio, waterfall and all, over USB or the network (by name only)

## RF Security & Research

Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, RFID, sub-GHz, packet capture, and consent-gated research tooling.

### Wi-Fi

Capture, handshake extraction and key recovery for Wi-Fi networks.

- [kismet](packages/kismet.md) — Wireless network and device detector, sniffer and logger for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and SDR sources (in [`rf-security`](profiles/rf-security.md))
- [skid-finder](packages/skid-finder.md) — Passive BLE-spam and Wi-Fi-attack detector with foxhunting, live alerts and a sensor-net collector (in [`rf-security`](profiles/rf-security.md))
